title: Lost in Moderation: How Commercial Content Moderation APIs Over- and Under-Moderate Group-Targeted Hate Speech and Linguistic Variations

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing group-level performance metrics (FPR, FNR, Pinned ROC AUC) on hate speech datasets and conducting Perturbation Sensitivity Analysis to compute Counterfactual Token Fairness by swapping marginalized racial/ethnic identity tokens (e.g., Black, Asian, Latinx) with dominant tokens (e.g., White).

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing group-level performance metrics (FPR, FNR, Pinned ROC AUC) on hate speech datasets and conducting Perturbation Sensitivity Analysis to compute Counterfactual Token Fairness by swapping LGBTQIA+ identity tokens with straight/heterosexual identity tokens.
